core_meaning.primary_meaning: Amilah is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Work, labour, industriousness”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Amilah corresponds to the Arabic form عاملة (Arabic root ع م ل (ʿ-m-l); عَامِلَة (ʿāmilah)). Its core sense is work, labour; industriousness. Amilah is Arabic عَامِلَة (ʿāmilah), the feminine active participle (fāʿilah pattern, feminine of عامل / ʿāmil) of عَمِلَ (ʿamila, 'to work, to act') from the root ع م ل (ʿ-m-l); as a given name it carries the sense 'Work, labour, industriousness'. Amilah is a variant romanization of Amila.

etymology.morphology: Feminine active participle (fāʿilah pattern, feminine of عامل) of عَمِلَ (ʿamila, 'to work, to act'), built on the root ع م ل.
etymology.etymological_meaning: From the root ع م ل (ʿ-m-l)
etymology.etymology_explanation: The form عاملة is an established Arabic lexical item — the feminine of عامل — and Amilah is the word itself used as a personal name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
etymology.false_etymology_warning: No derivation beyond the documented Arabic form is asserted. Any etymology that attributes this spelling to a different root or language without a source should be treated as unverified.

persian.name: عاملة
persian.long_meaning: Amilah (عاملة) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن کار، کوشش، تلاش است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: आमिला

arabic.name: عاملة
arabic.long_meaning: Amilah (عاملة) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي عمل، اجتهاد. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.
